purpose: Verify HR-EIS processes valid employee-centric service record operations within module scope
expected_result: Service record returned with employee details within module scope

purpose: Verify HR-EIS does not expose out-of-scope non-HR functionality
expected_result: Endpoint not found (404)

purpose: Verify user with authorized role can perform permitted HR action
preconditions: User is authenticated with faculty role
expected_result: Access granted (200 OK)

purpose: Verify user lacking required role is blocked by RBAC
preconditions: User is authenticated with faculty role without hr_admin permissions
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to update another employee's service record
expected_result: Access denied (403 Forbidden)

purpose: Verify employee can view own service record in read-only mode
preconditions: Employee is authenticated with active service record
expected_result: Own record returned read-only

purpose: Verify employee cannot alter own official service record data
action_or_input: Employee sends PATCH to own service record
expected_result: Modification denied (403 Forbidden)

purpose: Verify service record contains appointment details, department, designation, and leave balances
preconditions: Service record created with required composition fields
expected_result: All mandatory fields present and correctly typed

purpose: Verify HR Administrator has authority to create and modify service records
action_or_input: HR Admin creates new employee service record via API
expected_result: Service record created (201 Created)

purpose: Verify non-HR admin cannot create or modify service records
action_or_input: Regular employee attempts to create service record
expected_result: Request rejected with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify service record updates maintain database integrity and reject partial invalid updates
preconditions: Service record exists with baseline data
action_or_input: Attempt invalid update payload (e.g. invalid type or bad field)
expected_result: Update rejected; original record intact

purpose: Verify leave request with all required fields (type, duration, justification) is accepted
action_or_input: Submit leave with type, dates, duration, and justification
expected_result: Leave request created in pending state

purpose: Verify leave request missing justification is rejected
expected_result: Submission rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request)

purpose: Verify leave request within available balance is accepted (duration <= balance)
preconditions: Employee has casual balance of 5 days
action_or_input: Apply for 5 days of casual leave
expected_result: Request accepted successfully

purpose: Verify leave request exceeding available balance is rejected (duration > balance)
preconditions: Employee has casual balance of 5 days
action_or_input: Apply for 6 days of casual leave
expected_result: Submission rejected due to insufficient balance

purpose: Verify employee cannot apply for leave type for which category is ineligible
action_or_input: Staff employee applies for faculty Vacation leave
expected_result: Submission rejected due to ineligibility

purpose: Verify leave request is routed to the configured initial authority (HOD)
expected_result: current_authority_role is hod

purpose: Verify approving a leave request automatically deducts the exact leave duration from balance
preconditions: Leave request of 3 days pending HOD; balance is 10 days
expected_result: Balance updated automatically to 7 days in service record

purpose: Verify all leave lifecycle transactions are permanently logged in audit log
expected_result: Audit entries exist recording action and actor

purpose: Verify yearly appraisal submission is accepted within active submission window
expected_result: Appraisal accepted in submitted status

purpose: Verify yearly appraisal submission is rejected outside active submission window
expected_result: Submission rejected with error

purpose: Verify HR Administrator can assign reviewer(s) for appraisal evaluation
expected_result: Reviewers assigned and status updated to under_review

purpose: Verify appraisal passes through designated authorities for review and finalization
preconditions: Appraisal is under review by designated authority
action_or_input: Designated reviewer evaluates and Director finalizes
expected_result: Appraisal successfully finalized with final score

purpose: Verify finalized appraisal is archived in employee service record
expected_result: Appraisal event recorded in employee service history

purpose: Verify finalized appraisal cannot be modified after finalization
preconditions: Appraisal is finalized and is_immutable is True
action_or_input: Attempt to submit review or alter score on finalized appraisal
expected_result: Modification rejected; closed record preserved

purpose: Verify LTC Advance request type is supported with required travel block information
expected_result: LTC advance created in submitted state

purpose: Verify LTC Reimbursement request type is supported with claimed amount and bills
preconditions: Employee has completed travel with bills
expected_result: LTC reimbursement created in submitted state

purpose: Verify HR Administrator verifies LTC documentation and eligibility before approval routing
expected_result: LTC request marked verified and enters approval routing

purpose: Verify rejected verification prevents LTC request from entering approval routing
expected_result: LTC request marked rejected; does not enter approval routing

purpose: Verify approved LTC claim is processed and settled by Accountant
preconditions: LTC request is approved and verified
action_or_input: Accountant settles LTC claim with reference_id and passed_amount
expected_result: LTC claim marked settled and audit log recorded

purpose: Verify LTC payment status recorded without altering payroll structure or external finance rules
action_or_input: Verify settlement updates internal disbursement details only
expected_result: Internal settlement updated; payroll rules intact

purpose: Verify CPDA request with purpose, amount, and supporting documents is accepted
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request with all required fields
expected_result: CPDA request created in submitted status

purpose: Verify CPDA request with non-positive amount is rejected
expected_result: Submission rejected with validation error

purpose: Verify CPDA reimbursement request without supporting documents is rejected
action_or_input: Submit CPDA reimbursement with empty supporting documents
expected_result: Submission rejected due to missing documents

purpose: Verify HR Admin verifies CPDA claim before approval routing
expected_result: Claim marked verified and routed to approval authority

purpose: Verify unverified CPDA claim does not enter approval routing
expected_result: Claim marked rejected; does not enter approval routing

purpose: Verify Accountant processes approved CPDA claim, records voucher details, and deducts balance
preconditions: CPDA claim is approved; service record has CPDA balance
action_or_input: Accountant settles claim with voucher_no and passed_amount
expected_result: Claim marked settled and CPDA balance deducted in service record

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Approved outcome for routed HR request
expected_result: Request status becomes approved

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Rejected outcome ending approval path
expected_result: Request status becomes rejected

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Forwarded outcome advancing request to next authority
preconditions: Request is pending initial authority in multi-tier workflow
expected_result: Request status becomes forwarded/pending next authority

purpose: Verify system generates notification upon request submission
expected_result: Notification created with category=submission

purpose: Verify system generates notification upon request decision
expected_result: Notification created for decision event

purpose: Verify system generates notification for pending action reminder
preconditions: Request pending authority past reminder threshold
expected_result: Reminder notification created for pending authority

purpose: Verify system generates notification for configured policy deadline
preconditions: Appraisal deadline approaches within configured days
expected_result: Policy deadline notification generated for active employees

purpose: Verify audit log record contains actor identity, timestamp, and action performed
expected_result: Audit entry contains actor_id, timestamp, and action

purpose: Verify existing audit log records cannot be modified or deleted
action_or_input: Attempt to update audit log entry
expected_result: Audit log update prohibited / preserves historical integrity

purpose: Verify HR Administrator has authorized access to view audit log records
action_or_input: HR Admin queries audit log endpoint
expected_result: Audit logs returned successfully (200 OK)

purpose: Verify non-admin user cannot access audit logs
expected_result: Access denied (403 Forbidden)

purpose: Verify payment/disbursement reference is recorded without invoking external banking gateway
expected_result: Internal settlement status updated without external dependency

purpose: Verify HR-EIS consumes Fusion IAM identity token and enforces active role consistently
expected_result: Identity resolved correctly from token context

purpose: Verify HR-EIS does not expose direct role-assignment or privilege escalation APIs
action_or_input: Verify no endpoint exists for assigning platform IAM roles directly in HR-EIS
expected_result: Platform roles remain managed by Fusion IAM authority

purpose: Verify sensitive employee service record details are protected from unauthorized disclosure
action_or_input: Employee B attempts to access Employee A's record
expected_result: Access denied (403/404)

purpose: Verify HR-EIS does not modify payroll rules or execute salary computation
action_or_input: Verify HR-EIS scope is restricted to HR service workflows
expected_result: No payroll rules or salary structure modification functionality present

purpose: Verify notification is persisted in HR-EIS database for dashboard delivery even if email fails
expected_result: Notification record created in database with read status False

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Casual, Restricted, Medical, Earned, Vacation, and Sabbatical leave types
expected_result: All supported types accepted

purpose: Verify unsupported leave type (e.g. invalid_type) is rejected
expected_result: Submission rejected with validation error

purpose: Verify Accountant specifies passed amount and voucher details during settlement
action_or_input: Accountant settles claim with passed_amount and voucher_no
expected_result: Settlement recorded with passed amount verified
